result AS (
  SELECT 
    player_api_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN team_api_id = home_api THEN CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'win' WHEN home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 'loss' ELSE 'draw' END
      WHEN team_api_id = away_api THEN CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'win' WHEN away_team_goal < home_team_goal THEN 'loss' ELSE 'draw' END
    END AS result_type
  FROM player_matches
),
counts AS (
  SELECT 
    player_api_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN result_type = 'win' THEN 1 END) AS win_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN result_type = 'loss' THEN 1 END) AS loss_count
  FROM result
  GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT 'top_wins' AS category, p.player_name, c.win_count
FROM counts c
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = c.player_api_id
WHERE c.win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM counts)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'top_losses' AS category, p.player_name, c.loss_count
FROM counts c
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = c.player_api_id
WHERE c.loss_count = (SELECT MAX(loss_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY category, p.player_name
